comments.author: elviejo
comments.story: Ask HN: Is there a sane alternative to Angular and React?
comments.why: Gives a sense of what Elm does
comments.text: Excellent question. Turns out there is: [LINK] Is a Haskell inspired programming language that makes developing front end a delight. It helps to build Reliable front ends. Watch this conference to get a sense of what Elm does. Making the Backend Team Jelous[1] Plus the Elm architecture makes everything orderly and easy to understand. Quite a change from the mess of react components and Angular rewrites. [1] [VIDEO]
